l-e-h1-b04-34.title: Present perfect or present perfect continuous tense?
l-e-h1-b04-34.goal: Decide what information you really need to choose between the present perfect and present perfect continuous, and explain why you chose it.
l-e-h1-b04-34.material: A: I have painted the fence. It looks great. B: I have been painting the fence. My arms hurt. Find the information that distinguishes the two tenses.
l-e-h1-b04-34.s.s1.prompt: What information distinguishes the two tenses?
l-e-h1-b04-34.s.s1.r.a: The size of the object has nothing to do with the tense.

l-e-h1-b04-34.s.s1.o.d: Whether sentence dey positive or negative

l-e-h1-b04-34.s.s2.model.0: A tells the result that looks great, while B tells the ongoing action that made the arms hurt, so whether it is a result or ongoing action is the deciding information.
l-e-h1-b04-34.s.s2.model.1: A finished action's result uses the present perfect, while an ongoing action uses the present perfect continuous, so this information helps you tell them apart.

l-e-h1-b06-21.material: Sentence: I like tea; however, I drink am every day. Explanation: ① However introduce opposite thing to wetin come before ② Wetin come before na ‘I like tea’ ③ If you like am, drinking every day unexpected ④ So however correct.

l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s1.o.b: ② Wetin come before na ‘I like tea’
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s1.r.b: E match first part of sentence. Dis step correct.
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s1.o.c: ③ If you like tea, drinking am every day unexpected
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s1.explain: If you like something, e natural to drink am often. E no unexpected, so therefore fit pass more than however.
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s2.model.0: If you like something, e natural to drink am often, so e no unexpected. Dat make ③ wrong, and therefore correct.
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s2.model.1: E no opposite to wetin come before, so no use however; mistake start for ③.

l-e-h1-b06-29.title: Guessing from clues: where e go wrong?
l-e-h1-b06-29.goal: Follow the explanation of clues for a room where person just dey, or the cause-and-effect chain, step by step. Find the first place wey e go wrong and correct am.
l-e-h1-b06-29.material: Text: The soup still dey steam. One book dey open on the table. The back door dey open small. Explanation: ① The soup dey steam, so dem just cook am ② The book dey open, so person stop reading ③ The back door open, so person comot for small time ④ So na house wey everybody don leave long ago

l-e-h1-b06-29.s.s1.r.a: You fit tell from the first sentence of the text. This step correct.
l-e-h1-b06-29.s.s1.o.b: ② The book dey open, so person stop reading

l-e-h1-b06-29.s.s1.o.d: ④ Na house wey everybody don leave long ago

l-e-h1-b06-29.s.s2.model.1: All three clues point to something wey just happen, so correct ④ wey talk say e happen long ago.

l-e-h1-b07-05.title: Reading or Having read?

l-e-h1-b07-05.material: Solution to change ‘Since I had read the book twice, I skipped chapter one’ into participial clause. ① Subject of both clauses na same I ② Remove Since and subject I ③ Shorten had read to Reading ④ Answer: Reading book twice, I skipped chapter one.

l-e-h1-b07-05.s.s1.r.b: If subjects same, you fit remove conjunction and subject.
l-e-h1-b07-05.s.s1.o.c: ③ Shorten had read to Reading
l-e-h1-b07-05.s.s1.o.d: ④ Answer: Reading the book twice...

l-e-h1-b07-05.s.s2.model.1: Reading show same time as main clause, so correct ③ to Having read.

l-e-h1-b07-06.title: Change never to first time
l-e-h1-b07-06.goal: Change sentence about museum being first into another form (formula, table, picture, words), and explain why e mean same.
l-e-h1-b07-06.material: I never go to dis museum before. Change am to sentence with same meaning wey start ‘This is the first time’. This is the first time I ___ to this museum.
l-e-h1-b07-06.s.s1.r.a: Was talk about only one time for past, so e no fit show first experience reach now.
l-e-h1-b07-06.s.s1.r.b: Will be talk about future. E no mean say na first up to now.
l-e-h1-b07-06.s.s1.r.c: Time wey person dey speak na now, so use have been, no be had been.

l-e-h1-b01-33.s.s1.r.b: A talk about one part and B talk about everything, so dem different.

l-e-h1-b01-33.s.s1.r.c: A talk about only one detail.
l-e-h1-b01-33.s.s1.o.d: B: E join di whole text inside one sentence

l-e-h1-b01-33.s.s2.model.1: A na just one proof, so B, wey join everything, na di main-idea summary.

l-e-h1-b01-34.title: Weather permitting and Weather permitted
l-e-h1-b01-34.goal: Compare di two methods or claims, wey be di two sentences with participial phrases; choose di one wey fit pass and explain di reason.
l-e-h1-b01-34.material: E mean say we go hold picnic if weather fine. A: Weather permitting, we go hold di picnic. B: Weather permitted, we go hold di picnic.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.prompt: Choose di sentence wey fit pass and give di reason.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.o.a: A: Di subject of di participle na di same as subject of di main clause
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.r.a: For here, di subjects different: weather and we.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.o.b: A: Na weather dey allow by itself, so use -ing
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.o.c: B: Na weather dem dey allow, so use -ed
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.r.c: Na weather dey allow, no be say dem allow am.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.o.d: Di two mean di same thing
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.r.d: Di meaning dey change according to tense and form.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.explain: Weather na di one wey ‘allows’, so ‘permitting’ correct. Di participial phrase get its own separate subject.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s2.model.0: Weather na di one wey allow, so A, wey use active ‘permitting’, fit pass.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s2.model.1: Weather no be di one wey receive permission, so B, wey use -ed, no correct.

l-e-h1-b01-35.topic: Present perfect and present perfect continuous

l-e-h1-b01-35.s.s1.prompt: Which sentence describe di situation better?
l-e-h1-b01-35.s.s1.r.a: Di tenses different, so whether di work don finish or e still dey go on different.
l-e-h1-b01-35.s.s1.o.b: B: E mean say di painting work don dey go on
l-e-h1-b01-35.s.s1.o.c: A: E mean say di fence painting don finish
l-e-h1-b01-35.s.s1.r.c: A sound like say di painting don finish, so e no match di situation.
l-e-h1-b01-35.s.s1.o.d: A: Dem no fit use present perfect continuous
l-e-h1-b01-35.s.s1.r.d: Dem dey use present perfect continuous for activity wey still dey go on.
l-e-h1-b01-35.s.s1.explain: Dem dey use present perfect continuous to talk about work wey never finish. A sound like say di painting don finish.

l-e-h1-b01-35.s.s2.model.1: A sound like finished work, so e no match di situation wey dem don paint only half.

l-e-h1-b04-39.title: Is it Written or Writing?

l-e-h1-b04-39.s.s2.model.1: Book no fit do the writing, so active Writing no fit here.

l-e-h1-b06-40.material: Because it was built in 1900, the bridge is old. Conditions: ① Use participial clause ② Keep passive meaning ③ Grammar correct.
l-e-h1-b06-40.s.s1.r.a: The bridge go become the one wey build am, so e turn active.
l-e-h1-b06-40.s.s1.r.b: bridge singular, so na is, no be are.
l-e-h1-b06-40.s.s1.r.c: E mean "while dem dey build am", wey no agree with meaning say e old now.
l-e-h1-b06-40.s.s1.explain: Shorten Because it was built to Built and you keep passive meaning and reason.
l-e-h1-b06-40.s.s2.model.0: Past participle Built keep passive meaning, show reason, and grammar correct, so e meet all three conditions.
l-e-h1-b06-40.s.s2.model.1: Other sentences turn active, use wrong verb, or mix progressive meaning, so dis sentence correct.

l-e-h1-b07-08.title: Brief message say you go dey flight
l-e-h1-b07-08.goal: For text message say you go dey flight tomorrow for 3 o'clock, consider conditions wey clash, choose best balance and explain why.
l-e-h1-b07-08.material: Write text message to friend. Conditions: ① Say na 3 o'clock tomorrow ② Show say you go dey flight that time ③ 7 words or fewer.
l-e-h1-b07-08.s.s1.r.a: Will fly only talk about action of flying. E no mean say you dey in middle of am.
l-e-h1-b07-08.s.s1.r.c: Will have flown mean e don finish by then.
l-e-h1-b07-08.s.s1.r.d: E get 8 words, so e pass condition of 7 or fewer.
l-e-h1-b07-08.s.s1.explain: Will be flying mean you dey in middle of flight at dat time, and e get 7 words, so e meet all three conditions.
